about_title: Cold bevels for welding, from 1/8″ to 4-3/4″ plate
about_text: CEVISA has designed and built self-feeding bevelling machines in Vitoria, Spain, since 1969, and exports 80 % of its production to more than 60 countries. Its shearing bevellers take the bevel off cold with a resharpenable cutter — V, X, K and Y bevels on plate, tube and discs up to 1-15/16″ thick — and its milling bevellers machine bevels up to 3-15/16″ wide in any material, from mild steel to Hardox, at 15° to 70°. Inverted and reversible models bevel the lower edge without turning the plate.

NovoTech sells, installs and supports Cevisa bevellers in Canada from Mississauga, Ontario — the machine and cutters chosen for your plates and bevels, a CSA-approved panel, operator training, a 1-year warranty and parts and technical support in Canada.
